# Dharmik Gohil

> Unity game developer and XR/AR-VR specialist based in Surat, Gujarat, India. Final-year B.Tech IT student at CHARUSAT University (DEPSTAR College), available for hire on Unity 3D/2D games, real-time multiplayer (Photon PUN), AR/VR/XR experiences, and full-stack web development (React, Node.js, MongoDB).

Dharmik Gohil builds shipped, playable games — not just prototypes. He has 10+ published titles on itch.io, has won hackathons including IIT Bombay Techfest 2025, Hack-A-Vation, and Hackron 2025, and co-founded the Indian Developer Community (IDC), a 150+ member community for Indian game and software developers.

- Coordinates / HQ: Surat, Gujarat, India (21.1702 N, 72.8311 E) with 100% remote delivery capabilities.

## Services

- Unity 3D/2D game development (single-player and multiplayer)
- Real-time multiplayer games with Photon PUN (lobbies, matchmaking, player sync)

- Full-stack web development (React, Node.js, MongoDB, MySQL)
- ERPNext implementation and business process automation

- n8n workflow automation

### Articles

- [LOWXENA: Designing and Engineering a 3D Multiplayer Card Universe Where the Lowest Score Wins Everything](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/lowxena-game-development-insights.html): Inside LowXena, a real-time multiplayer least-count card game: scoring logic, 3D felt table, React 19 front end and WebSocket state synchronization.
- [Getting Started with Unity Game Development: A Beginner's Complete Guide](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/getting-started-unity-game-development.html): Learn Unity step by step: install the editor, understand GameObjects and components, write your first C# script, add physics and build a simple 2D game.
- [React vs Next.js: Which Framework Should You Choose in 2026?](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/react-vs-nextjs-which-to-choose.html): React or Next.js? Compare rendering strategies, routing, SEO and when each makes sense, with a clear recommendation from a full-stack developer.
- [Building Multiplayer Games with Photon & Unity: A Complete Guide](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/multiplayer-games-photon-unity.html): Build multiplayer Unity games with Photon PUN2: rooms and lobbies, player synchronization, RPCs, spawning, latency handling and lessons from a shipped shooter.
- [Git & GitHub Essential Commands: The Complete Developer Cheatsheet](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/git-github-essential-commands.html): The Git and GitHub commands developers use daily: setup, staging, branching, merging and rebasing, remotes, stashing, history and undoing mistakes.
- [DAIICT Hackathon: Building an AI-Powered Meeting Monitor Application](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/daiict-hackathon-ai-meeting-monitor.html): How our team built an AI meeting assistant at the DAIICT Hackathon in Gandhinagar: real-time transcription, summaries, action items and engagement insights.
- [A Proud Moment: Showcasing Mavericks Battlegrounds at CHARUSAT Expo 3.0](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/charusat-expo-3-mavericks-battlegrounds-showcase.html): How Mavericks Battlegrounds became the only IT Department project selected for CHARUSAT Expo 3.0, what 5000+ visitors told us and the changes we shipped after.
- [Essential Unity Game Development Tips for Aspiring Developers](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/unity-game-development-tips.html): Five Unity habits that save projects: master the fundamentals, optimize early, organize assets, write clean C# and test on real devices.
- [VR/AR: Revolutionizing the Gaming Industry](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/vr-ar-future-gaming.html): Where VR and AR gaming stands today, why it is growing, the development challenges and opportunities, and how to start building with Unity XR.
- [Essential Mobile Game Optimization Techniques for Unity Developers](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/mobile-game-optimization.html): Make Unity games run smoothly on phones: understand hardware limits, reduce draw calls, compress textures, manage memory and profile on real devices.
- [My Educational Journey at CHARUSAT University DEPSTAR College](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/charusat-university-experience.html): What studying computer engineering at CHARUSAT University’s DEPSTAR College was like, how it led me into game development and advice for future students.
- [Your Complete Guide to Starting a Career in Game Development](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/game-developer-career-guide.html): How to start a game development career: roles, essential skills, learning path, portfolio advice, finding a first job and growing from there.
- [Getting Started with Unity XR: A Complete Guide to VR and AR Development](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/getting-started-unity-xr.html): Build your first VR and AR apps in Unity: set up the XR environment, learn VR basics, use AR Foundation and apply performance and comfort best practices.
- [Mavericks Battlegrounds: The Best Multiplayer Battle Arena Game of 2025 by Award-Winning Developer Dharmik Gohil](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/mavericks-battlegrounds-game-development-journey.html): The development story of Mavericks Battlegrounds, a Unity 6 and Photon PUN multiplayer arena shooter: team, process, timeline, tech stack and screenshots.
- [Hackron Hackathon 2025: Our 24-Hour Journey Building SafaiNova for Blinkit](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/hackron-hackathon-2025-blinkit-experience.html): Our 24-hour build at Hackron 2025 (Blinkit and Newton School of Technology): SafaiNova, an AI and IoT waste-management concept for dark stores, and what we learned.
- [My Unforgettable Journey at IIT Bombay TechFest'24](https://dharmikgohil.art/blog/iit-bombay-techfest-2024-experience.html): My experience at IIT Bombay TechFest 2024, Asia’s largest science and tech festival: a game development workshop, robotics, drones and what I took home.
